extras: Requires Obsidian 1.1.9 or newer. Mobile, stacked tabs, and sidebar tabs retain native appearance.
intentEvidence: Keep your pinned notes within reach while leaving more room for other tabs.
problem: Standard pinned tabs consume excessive screen space, making the workspace cluttered and reducing available viewing area.
summary: A utility that compact pins tabs in Obsidian to reduce their visual footprint and free up screen real estate.
